title: Navigating Uncertainty
summary:
Geopolitics has returned to the oil and tanker markets
Geopolitics are intricately linked with the international oil and shipping markets, influencing commodity prices, supply and demand balances and logistics. Developments over the last few weeks have served as a stark reminder of this. Since the beginning of 2025, there have been a number of market developments and government actions that created significant volatility and uncertainty in the energy and shipping markets.
